answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across clusters. When suspicious node clusters attempt a partition attack, auditing nodes stake deposits; if cut verifications expose colluding clones, stake slashing burns their bonded assets. This mechanism scales attacker cost at a superlinear rate past the horizon of initial capital. Each auditor signs validation verdicts with a cryptographic quill, tagging fraud under a violet spectral alert.
